name: com.gameframex.unity.operationkeyboard.kuaishouminigame
displayName: Game Frame X Operation Keyboard (KuaiShou Mini Game)
description:
Kuaishou Mini Game keyboard adapter for GameFrameX OperationKeyboard. Implements IOperationKeyboardManager over KS.ShowKeyboard / KS.HideKeyboard / KS.UpdateKeyboard with an event surface isomorphic to WeChat, including On/OffKeyboardHeightChange, and self-registers into OperationKeyboardRegistry at BeforeSceneLoad via KuaiShouMiniGameOperationKeyboardBootstrap (code is stripped and registration does not happen when UNITY_WEBGL / ENABLE_KUAISHOU_MINI_GAME / ENABLE_KUAISHOU_MINI_GAME_OPERATIONKEYBOARD macros are not enabled — referencing means registering). maxLength is passed through as -1 to keep pinyin composition intact. Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX OperationKeyboard 的快手小游戏键盘适配渠道包。基于 KS.ShowKeyboard / KS.HideKeyboard / KS.UpdateKeyboard 与 On/OffKeyboardInput / Confirm / Complete / HeightChange 实现 IOperationKeyboardManager（事件面与微信同构，含键盘高度），由 KuaiShouMiniGameOperationKeyboardBootstrap 在 BeforeSceneLoad 阶段自注册进 OperationKeyboardRegistry（宏 UNITY_WEBGL / ENABLE_KUAISHOU_MINI_GAME / ENABLE_KUAISHOU_MINI_GAME_OPERATIONKEYBOARD 未启用时代码被裁剪、注册不发生，引用即注册）。maxLength 恒传 -1 以保护拼音组合输入。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
